title: Use Case Testing — Overview
summary: Deriving tests from use-case flows: main success plus every alternate and exception path.
body:
Deriving tests from use-case flows: main success plus every alternate and exception path. Standard requirements-based technique.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Requirements Testing, Acceptance Testing, BDD.
